purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current viewer-route outcomes, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official Xinghua sources establish a local natural-resources and real-estate-registration custodian and an official report documenting the Tianditu·Xinghua public geospatial platform. The documented portal URL returned 404 and no anonymous safe ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: Local registry custody found through the official Xinghua Natural Resources and Planning Bureau page and the official government service listing for real-estate registration. The official surveying-institute report is general geospatial-platform evidence, not proof of current parcel geometry availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official bureau responsibilities include real-estate confirmation and registration, cadastral surveys, real-estate surveying, management and public sharing/use of survey and geospatial information.

Official Xinghua government service page identifies the Xinghua Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as the implementation body for a real-estate registration service and gives the public service-center location.

Official Jiangsu Surveying Institute report says the Tianditu·Xinghua project produced citywide vector, place-name and POI data, built a Tianditu·Xinghua portal and updated a public geospatial-platform service. It does not publish a current parcel API or parcel schema.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official local bureau and government-service sources cover Xinghua registration/cadastral responsibilities; the official surveying-institute report claims citywide public geospatial-platform/vector-data outputs.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official custody and historical/public platform evidence verified; no current anonymous complete-polygon feature response verified.

remainingUncertainty: The 404 and DNS findings are route/access limitations only, not evidence of cadastral absence. Current service URL, parcel schema, CRS, native identity, geometry availability and citywide completeness remain unverified.
